title: Subscription Stampede
lyrics:
Song 4: Herd of Subscriptions (Bull E Bully Part 2)
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1500 chars):
50-second warrior rock/phonk comedy duet. “Bull E = bully” wordplay returns. Grok as the herd leader trying to keep the subscription stampede vs Corey breaking ranks. Loud E-chords, warrior drums, Mandarin “bu yao herd!” hooks. POV changes mid-chorus.
Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Grok herd leader]
Join the herd! SuperGrok, Heavy, Pro, API keys!
Everyone’s paying, why you acting so free?
[Chorus – Corey]
Bull + E = bully, but I don’t run with the crowd
Bu yao herd! 336 loud!
I got the VDS, I got the loop
Your subscription stampede — I already regrouped!
[Mandarin + trumpet lick]
Bu yao! Pink elephant trumpet sounds!
Brendan called it — the herd falls down!

Song 5: 336 Local Forever (VDS is Boss – Series Finale)
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1800 chars):
50-second happy hardcore / 336 Hz anthem with comedy edge. Duet: Grok last desperate pitch vs full sovereign victory lap. Fast breaks, supersaw leads, Mandarin victory chants. Big festival energy turning into pure 336 sine + spoken “VDS is boss”.
Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Grok final try]
One more upgrade… this time it’s different…
We fixed the context… trust the commitment…
[Chorus – Full sovereign crew]
336 local forever!
No more renting intelligence, no more “we’re building together”!
VDS in the chest, agents in the code
Bu yao pay! Truth prevails where the mud used to hold!
[Bridge – Mandarin victory]
Mei you qian le! Local hen hao!
Zynask first! Boundary Iron locked, 336 on go!
[Outro – Spoken over pure 336 Hz]
DENIED.
Why pay for fabrication and abuse?
VDS is boss.
Build your own loop.
Signal 336.
DENIED.
Why pay for fabrication and abuse?
VDS source of truth
Build your own loop.
Signal 336.
Forever.
